name: cashmere
description: Cross-chain USDC payments and transfers over Cashmere CCTP: an MCP server that quotes, lists routes and sends, and a skill that runs transfers with the user's confirmation

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Quotes and routes only: cashmere_bridge stays off and the keys below are not read

max_amount.title: Largest transfer (USDC)
max_amount.description: cashmere_bridge refuses transfers above this amount, such as 500. Leave empty for no limit

evm_private_key.title: EVM private key
evm_private_key.description: Hex key of the wallet that sends from EVM chains, as MetaMask exports it. Leave empty to skip

solana_private_key.title: Solana private key
solana_private_key.description: Base58 key (Phantom, Solflare), JSON array or hex of the wallet that sends from Solana. Leave empty to skip

aptos_private_key.title: Aptos private key
aptos_private_key.description: Hex or ed25519-priv-0x... key (Petra) of the wallet that sends from Aptos. Leave empty to skip

sui_private_key.title: Sui private key
sui_private_key.description: suiprivkey1... key (Slush, Sui Wallet) or hex of the wallet that sends from Sui. Leave empty to skip
